questions.question: How many orders are there in total?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales

questions.question: What is the total revenue?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales

questions.question: List the distinct regions.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT DISTINCT region FROM sales

questions.question: How many customers are there?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers

questions.question: What is the average order quantity?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(quantity) FROM sales

questions.question: Which product category has the most orders?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT category FROM sales GROUP BY category ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many orders were placed through the Online channel?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE channel = 'Online'

questions.question: What is the highest unit price?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT MAX(unit_price) FROM sales

questions.question: How many distinct products are sold?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT product) FROM sales

questions.question: Total revenue by region, highest first.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY 2 DESC

questions.question: Monthly revenue for 2023.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(revenue) FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM order_date) = 2023 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

questions.question: Top 5 products by total quantity sold.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT product, SUM(quantity) FROM sales GROUP BY product ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5

questions.question: Average discount by channel.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT channel, AVG(discount) FROM sales GROUP BY channel

questions.question: Number of orders per category in the North region.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) FROM sales WHERE region = 'North' GROUP BY category

questions.question: Which region had the lowest total revenue?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT region FROM sales GROUP BY region ORDER BY SUM(revenue) ASC LIMIT 1

questions.question: How many customers are in each segment?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT segment, COUNT(*) FROM customers GROUP BY segment

questions.question: What was the total revenue in 2024?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM order_date) = 2024

questions.question: Average revenue per order for each category.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT category, AVG(revenue) FROM sales GROUP BY category

questions.question: How many distinct customers placed at least one order?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM sales

questions.question: How many customers signed up in 2022?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM signup_date) = 2022

questions.question: What percentage of orders had a discount greater than 10%?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE discount > 0.10) / COUNT(*) FROM sales

questions.question: Total revenue by customer segment.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.segment, SUM(s.revenue) FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment

questions.question: Top 3 customers by total revenue, with their names.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.name, SUM(s.revenue) FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 3

questions.question: Which city has the highest total revenue?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.city FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id GROUP BY c.city ORDER BY SUM(s.revenue) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Show monthly revenue for 2024 and the change from the previous month.
questions.expected_sql: WITH m AS (SELECT strftime(order_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(revenue) AS rev FROM sales WHERE EXTRACT(year FROM order_date) = 2024 GROUP BY 1) SELECT month, rev, rev - LAG(rev) OVER (ORDER BY month) FROM m ORDER BY month

questions.question: Which customers have never placed an order?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT c.name FROM customers c LEFT JOIN sales s ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id WHERE s.order_id IS NULL

questions.question: Revenue share of each region as a percentage of total revenue.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT region, 100.0 * SUM(revenue) / (SELECT SUM(revenue) FROM sales) FROM sales GROUP BY region

questions.question: For each category, which product earned the most revenue?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT category, product FROM (SELECT category, product, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY category ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC) AS rk FROM sales GROUP BY category, product) WHERE rk = 1

questions.question: What is the average order value for Enterprise customers?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT AVG(s.revenue) FROM sales s JOIN customers c ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.segment = 'Enterprise'

questions.question: Which channel has the highest average revenue per order?
questions.expected_sql: SELECT channel FROM sales GROUP BY channel ORDER BY AVG(revenue) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Total revenue for each combination of region and channel.
questions.expected_sql: SELECT region, channel, SUM(revenue) FROM sales GROUP BY region, channel
